item.title: Ask HN: How do you get AI loops to converge? (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: For any arbitrary coding task, how can a Ralph loop break out of a local minima and converge, such that, even if the loop runs again, there are no tasks left to complete? I want to learn more resources for loop engineering, deterministic tooling etc. What I am noticing is the agents/subagents oscillate between repeatedly patching the same bits of code over and over, or introducing new bugs. Thank you! Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50211080 Points: 1 # Comments: 0

item.title: Show HN: Anyone else frustrated with mermaid diagrams? (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: I've been struggling with Mermaid in Markdown for a while. I appreciate the technical finesse of its rendering, but the diagrams are often unreadable. So we wrote an alternative that is optimized for MCP and LLMs while still looking good to humans. The LLM can position elements, and it stays Markdown-compatible. It's MIT licensed, and I hope you can use it. our rational: https://uberblick.ai/blog/2026/why-we-dropped-mermaid Cheers Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50211015 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
